rows.name: 05_whitespace_heredoc
rows.reason: Accepted v0.3 TrailingWhitespace policy: blanks inside a heredoc body or a multi-line string are reported but kept, as removing them changes the literal value (upstream's edits change the AST).

rows.name: 30_line_dir
rows.reason: Accepted v0.3 position guard: removing blank lines before `__LINE__` changes its value (upstream's edit changes the AST).

rows.name: 34_directives
rows.reason: Directive prefix: `# rustocop:disable` suppresses detection and correction in rustocop; RuboCop ignores that prefix. Directive prefix: the `# rustocop:disable` line is suppressed in rustocop only.

rows.name: 35_tabs_heredoc
rows.reason: IndentationStyle keeps the tab before a `<<-` terminator (documented hold); ClosingHeredocIndentation then inserts spaces before the tab, as upstream's ClosingHeredocIndentation alone does, where upstream's IndentationStyle converts the tab.

rows.name: 46_crlf
rows.reason: Accepted CRLF preservation: rustocop keeps every CRLF; the pinned Parser buffer hands back the corrected source with LF. Otherwise identical (checked).

rows.name: 61_ll_lengthened
rows.reason: Accepted v0.3 policy: Layout/LineLength is detection-only; upstream's LineLength autocorrect breaks the lengthened array literal after its first element.
